worker-rotation.title: Rotate node credential
worker-rotation.subtitle: Review the original node and confirm it has stopped before issuing a replacement.
worker-rotation.stop_instructions: Stop the Runner process on its machine and keep its working files and execution records.
worker-rotation.boundary: The previous credential becomes invalid immediately when rotation completes. The server checks for unresolved execution before issuing a replacement.
worker-rotation.acknowledge: I have stopped the original Runner process.
worker-rotation.conflict_remedy: Resolve any unfinished execution or result checks, then refresh the node and review rotation again.
worker-rotation.install: Save this one-time credential as SUMA_RUNNER_TOKEN in the controlled Runner configuration, then restart the same node. A new inventory report establishes its current availability.
worker-rotation.metadata_only: The rotation receipt was recovered. The one-time credential was not recovered. If you do not have it, refresh this node and explicitly start another rotation.
worker-rotation.copy_failed: Clipboard unavailable. Reveal the credential and copy it manually.
worker-rotation.invalid_request: The rotation request does not match the current project, node, or confirmed version.
worker-rotation.invalid_response: The rotation receipt could not be verified. Recover the original operation before issuing another credential.
